name: Google Account Authorization
description: Shared Google OAuth plumbing (one OAuth client, any number of accounts) used by google_calendar, google_contacts and google_mail. Provides no tools of its own -- installing any of those pulls this in as a dependency.

config.label: OAuth client credentials.json
config.description: Path to the OAuth client credentials.json downloaded from Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services > Credentials > OAuth client ID > Desktop app). One client authorizes every account.

config.label: Requested scopes
config.description: Google API scopes to ask for, comma-separated. Leave empty for the default set (Calendar, Contacts and Mail), which is what the three Google tool packages collectively need. Narrowing this invalidates tokens you already have.

actions.label: Add a Google account
actions.description: Authorize an account. Gives you a link to open on any device and takes back the address it redirects to, so this works on a server you only reach over SSH.

params.label: Account name
params.description: A short name you will refer to this account by, e.g. personal or work. Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.

actions.label: Authorized accounts
actions.description: List every authorized account and whether its token still works.

actions.label: Remove an account
actions.description: Delete one account's stored authorization. It can be added again at any time.

actions.label: Add an account using this machine's browser
actions.description: Opens a consent page on the machine the backend runs on. Only useful when that is your own computer -- on a server, use 'Add a Google account' instead.
